What to know

  • LDL and atherosclerosis. Oxidized LDL is taken up by macrophages, which become foam cells and drive plaque formation. High LDL is a causal risk factor.
  • Statins inhibit HMG-CoA reductase. They reduce liver cholesterol synthesis, upregulate LDL receptors, and lower blood LDL.
  • The lipid panel is a risk tool. It reports total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, and triglycerides; the ratio and absolute LDL matter more than total cholesterol alone.
  • Obesity is energy imbalance with biology. Appetite, insulin resistance, physical activity, sleep, and environment all contribute; treatment is not simply willpower.
  • Ketogenic diets shift fuel. Very low carbohydrate intake lowers insulin, increases lipolysis and ketogenesis, and can reduce seizures in some patients; long-term adherence and safety need monitoring.
